solution.title: SharePoint Online Migration Manager & Readiness Hub

shortDescription.default: SharePoint Online Migration Manager & Readiness Hub (SORRMH) — Pre-Flight Assessment, Character Remediation, Permissions Alignment, Target SPO & Azure Pipeline, and Executive Reporting.

longDescription.default: Full-featured SharePoint Framework (SPFx) Web Part mirroring the PowerShell SharePoint Online Migration Manager & Readiness Hub. Includes multi-environment profile targeting (Dev, QA, Staging, Production), source inventory scanning & SHA-256 verification, ASCII directory tree generation, bottom-up character remediation & rollback script generation, NTFS permissions & Entra ID UPN alignment, live SharePoint library & storage quota inspection, 50 GB batch throughput benchmarking, anomaly monitoring, and standalone HTML executive report generation.
